en: The image appears to be a reproduction of a medieval European painting printed as a postcard. It shows a stylized scene with two human figures in front of castle-like architecture. On the right, a woman in a long green and yellow gown stands under a small tower or gateway, reading or holding an open book, with a small white animal (likely a dog) at her feet. On the left, a man in a red outfit and hat walks out of a fortified gate or castle doorway, holding an object in his arms, while another white animal runs along a path. The background consists of worn, fresco-like walls and towers in muted tones, giving an aged, historical look. There is no visible printed text or caption on the postcard front.
